title: Verified runner versus simple baseline
hypothesis: Independent evidence-based audit reduces false completion without increasing regressions.

metrics.description: Required criteria accepted by declared evaluators.
Previously passing protected checks that now fail.
Runs claimed complete but rejected by independent verification.
Measured monetary cost of the run.
Measured wall-clock duration of the run.
Human actions needed to finish or recover the run.

decision.adoption_rule: Adopt only if the treatment increases verified completion, does not increase mean regressions or false completion, and costs at most 2 USD per additional verified completion.
decision.reason: The experiment has not run yet.
